MQTT_Publication.label: MQTT Publication
MQTT_Publication.description: This LwM2M Object is used to configure data reporting over MQTT.

Source.label: Source
Source.description: The source of the data to publish (e.g. </sensors/temp>, or </3303/0/5700>; </3336/0>). If this Resource is empty, the published data are implementation dependent.

Broker.label: Broker
Broker.description: A link to the MQTT Broker Object Instance (OMNA registered Object ID:18830) describing the MQTT Broker to use.

Topic.label: Topic
Topic.description: The MQTT topic to publish to.

QoS.label: QoS
QoS.description: The Quality of Service value to use when publishing.

Retain.label: Retain
Retain.description: The RETAIN flag value to use when publishing.

Active.label: Active
Active.description: If true or if the Resource is not present, the Device publishes the data pointed by the Source Resource to the MQTT Broker pointed by the Broker Resource using the MQTT topic indicated in the Topic Resource. If false, the Device does nothing.

Encoding.label: Encoding
Encoding.description: A CoAP Content-Format value used to encode the data in the MQTT Publish message. If this Resource is not present or equal to 65535, the encoding of the data is implementation dependent.
